_readme: This file defines how each document type is processed by the ingest pipeline.
Edit document_types to add new types or change existing ones, then ask for implementation.
HEADER FORMAT (first line of every handwritten note):
vision         Apple Vision OCR — crops top 20% and extracts header line
parse_header   Splits header into vault_name, doc_type, fields dict
transcribe     AI transcription of the full note body
diagram        AI diagram conversion using type-constrained prompt (DIAGRAM only)
FALLBACK STAGES (injected automatically, not listed per-type):
write_pending  Written when validate fails — holds partial note for follow-up
NULL values mean: inherit from defaults.

prompts.transcription: Transcribe all handwritten text in this image exactly as written. Preserve line breaks. Output only the transcribed text.
prompts.diagram:
Convert the handwritten diagram in this image to {format} syntax.
You may ONLY use the following elements — do not introduce any syntax not in this list:
{elements}

Output only the raw {format} code block. No explanation.

TASK.description: Creates a new task in the target vault.
TASK.transcription_prompt: Transcribe this handwritten task note. Identify and preserve: task title, description, and any acceptance criteria or sub-steps listed. Format as structured Markdown.

TASK_UPDATE.description: Updates an existing task — appends status change or new information.
TASK_UPDATE.transcription_prompt: Transcribe this handwritten task update. Identify: the referenced task (ref field), any status change, and the update content. Output as structured Markdown.

WORKFLOW.description: Documents a workflow — process steps, decision points, AI subtask preparation.
WORKFLOW.transcription_prompt: Transcribe this handwritten workflow document. Preserve headings, numbered steps, decision branches, and any listed subtasks. Format as structured Markdown with clear hierarchy.

DIAGRAM.description: Converts a handwritten diagram to Mermaid or PlantUML code.

NOTE.description: Free-form note — transcribed and filed without field validation.
